_comment: EPISODE 1, TAKE A of three (seeds 4817, 4818, 4819). The OPENING: the premise lands and two people are wrong in an ordinary way. product and location are IDENTICAL BYTE FOR BYTE across all three configs - that is what makes the three generations read as one shoot, and check-cut.py's provenance check C compares the location clause across the three manifests rather than trusting this comment. Built with the pace and guard grammars, both recorded in generation so the config is self-describing and the gate does not have to guess which clauses to lint for.
